hypothesis: A gauge-invariant local propagation representation improves wavespeed identification from frequency-poor complex responses on an independent public wave benchmark.

matched_model.architecture: shared four-slot set operator plus scalar field decoder

primary_analysis: error versus all frequency subsets of sizes 1, 2, 3, and 4
promotion_gate: phase-aware representation improves raw by at least 15% in two frequency-poor budgets with the same sign for all three seeds
stop_rule: If neither phase representation beats raw in the one- and two-frequency regimes, do not claim cross-dataset measurement efficiency and audit source conventions and target identifiability before changing the model.
